# Avsnitt 599 - Positionera sig för krasch på uppsidan

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-09-22  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Fill or Kill episode 599 covers Novo Nordisk's disappointing capital markets day, Viking Therapeutics' strong oral GLP-1 data, Meta's on-device AI agent Muse driving a potential hardware upgrade cycle for CPU makers (Apple, Intel, AMD, ARM), and geopolitics ahead of the UN week and the Xi-Trump meeting. The hosts lean risk-on into the US midterms: they expect the Treasury/Bessent to push rates and oil down, which could support small caps, and they would not short or go long oil. They also flag elevated VIX as a 'crash to the upside' risk. The episode closes with a crypto interview with Virtune's CEO about Bitcoin as a macro/store-of-value trade and about tokenization (Chainlink, Arbitrum, Ethereum).

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

CMD offered only 2035 targets, stock -7.5% in minutes; hosts not tempted to buy, possible value trap

#### Reasoning

Hosts said they were not tempted to buy after a CMD with no concrete news. Semaglutide generics are coming (Sandoz in Canada), Lilly has taken the brand, and the pipeline needs building. It trades at ~10x earnings with a strong balance sheet, so it could be a value trap unless acquisitions or a wider pipeline appear. One host scalped a long and stopped out flat.

#### Sell Triggers

- meaningful acquisitions or pipeline broadening announced
- new indications with positive data

> *"man blev inte köpsugen men man känner ju mer att någonting måste de göra"*

---

### 🟡 QURE — uniQure | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host holds; 4-year Huntington's data expected before 30 Sept; FDA reversal allows filing on 3-year data

#### Reasoning

Host owns uniQure and awaits 4-year AMT-130 data. The earlier data was strong and a more pragmatic FDA reversed its rejection. The disease has no treatment, and the delivery method could make uniQure a platform company.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak 4-year data
- FDA filing setback

> *"Unicure har jag väl nämnt i podden några gånger. Jag tror att de kommer med data imorgon."*

---

### 🟡 ABCL — AbCellera | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host holds, has not sold after strong run, more data coming soon

#### Reasoning

Host holds AbCellera, which has performed well and has upcoming data. The host has not taken profits.

#### Sell Triggers

- disappointing clinical data

> *"Nu har ju den gått väldigt bra här. Och de kommer ju snart med mer data."*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta Platforms | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Muse on-device agent #1 on App Store, stock +11%; distribution advantage as models commoditize

#### Reasoning

Hosts see Meta's distribution as decisive now that AI models are becoming commoditized. The on-device agent saves tokens and could be monetized through ads. They call it a new angle in the AI race but gave no explicit buy call.

#### Sell Triggers

- Muse adoption fades
- no clear monetization

> *"Men varför Meta gick upp var ju ingen konstighet. distribution."*

---

### 🟠 AAPL — Apple | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Potential beneficiary of on-device AI hardware upgrade cycle; new hardware-focused CEO

#### Reasoning

If on-device agents take off, phones and laptops need upgrading, and Apple controls much of the hardware people use to reach AI. The new CEO is a hardware person. The hosts are speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- no AI-driven upgrade cycle materializes

> *"Så det blir ju en uppgraderingscykel av hårdvara."*

---

### 🟠 SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host traded long; moves in group with US AI peers

#### Reasoning

Host day-traded Sivers long as a group play on US AI semis. There is no fundamental thesis.

#### Sell Triggers

- US AI semis sell off

> *"Till och med handlat lite Sivers från långsidan. Allt handlar i grupp."*

---

### 🟠 BABA — Alibaba | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Released AI agent; Chinese AI stocks at very low multiples vs Western peers

#### Reasoning

Host notes Chinese AI companies trade at a fraction of Western multiples and have a huge domestic user base. A Xi-Trump deal could act as a catalyst, but such meetings are often anticlimactic.

#### Sell Triggers

- Xi-Trump talks fail
- escalating US-China tensions

> *"De handlas ju superlåg värdering alla kinesiska bolag."*
